opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition‑fee support, and enrolled on an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher‑education institution (including universities, Glasgow School of Art, Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, SRUC). Must not have already graduated unless applying for a second degree under specific conditions.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition‑fee grants of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students to cover the cost of tuition fees for the academic year 2026‑27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates from low‑income Scottish households who are undertaking a two‑year full‑time Master's programme at a Scottish university. Applicants must meet income thresholds and be eligible for the scheme.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year (capped) to support the costs of postgraduate study for eligible graduates, potentially covering both years of a two‑year Master's programme.
